title: Computerized Adaptive Testing of the Big Five with the Rating Scale Model

Two caveats: Model fit. graded response model fits better rating scale model (lower AIC BIC every trait), rating scale model gives every item slope thresholds. app supports rating scale model ; CAT tab golemirt graded models. what: Category response probabilities of the rating scale model — Pi_rsm
title: Category response probabilities of the rating scale model — Pi_rsm
text: probability answer category, first derivative, ability value, rating scale model Andrich (1978): $$P(X = k \mid \theta) = \frac{\exp \sum_{t=1}^{k} D(\theta - (\lambda_j + \delta_t))}   {\sum_{h=0}^{m} \exp \sum_{t=1}^{h} D(\theta - (\lambda_j + \delta_t))}$$ empty sum category 0 equal zero. returns result catR::Pi(model = "RSM").

code: bank <- matrix(c(-0.560, -0.230, 1.559, 0.071, 0.129,                  rep(1.715, 5), rep(0.461, 5), rep(-1.265, 5), rep(-0.687, 5)),                nrow = 5,                dimnames = list(1:5, c("lambdaj", "delta1", "delta2", "delta3", "delta4"))) next_item_rsm(theta = 0, bank) #> $item #> [1] 4 #>  #> $info #> [1] 3.061434 #>  #> $available #> [1] 1 2 3 4 5 #>  next_item_rsm(theta = 1.5, bank, out = c(4, 5)) #> $item #> [1] 3 #>  #> $info #> [1] 3.076108 #>  #> $available #> [1] 1 2 3 #>  # a short adaptive test responses <- c() administered <- c() theta <- 0 for (step in 1:4) {   item <- next_item_rsm(theta, bank, out = administered)$item   administered <- c(administered, item)   responses <- c(responses, 4) # the answer, scored 0 to 4   theta <- eap_est_rsm(bank[administered, , drop = FALSE], responses)   cat("step", step, "item", item, "theta", round(theta, 4),       "se", round(eap_se_rsm(theta, bank[administered, , drop = FALSE], responses), 4), "\n") } #> step 1 item 4 theta 0.8477 se 0.6921  #> step 2 item 5 theta 1.0943 se 0.6324  #> step 3 item 3 theta 1.8299 se 0.5575  #> step 4 item 2 theta 1.8537 se 0.553
